comparison.objective: Sharpen both faces of a kitchen knife on a whetstone and leave it safely oriented.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained angle and contact-force control during edge-leading strokes with face changes and coverage, not bimanual load sharing or sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Measured edge sharpness in real trials or qualified bilateral stroke/coverage proxy in simulation, followed by safe released placement and 1 s stability. Candidate requires ≥98% media passage and complete washer retention. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Repeated controlled motion is only a generic primitive; abrasive edge formation at a constrained angle is a different tested ability from selective screening.
